ammonia.reason: Moderate deamination with SN 52% but interior blue pH 5.9 keeps NH3 low, no ammonia quantified.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol and indole not detected in vacuum distillate, no fecal phenols from cow feed.

bitter.reason: Extensive proteolysis SN 51.98% yields hydrophobic bitter peptides enhanced by 3.76% NaCl.

blue_moldy.reason: Penicillium roqueforti beta-oxidation gives 2-nonanone 4570 plus 2-heptanone 1810 ug/kg.

browning.reason: Aged 45d-4mo lactose depleted, low residual reducing sugar limits Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin not found; buttery from gamma-dodecalactone 1030 plus delta-dodecalactone 700 ug/kg.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Total FFA 86000 mg/kg with butyric 1565 and hexanoic 10916 mg/kg from lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: Moisture 47.09% plus fat 28.42% FDM 53.7% with proteolyzed smooth paste and lactones.

crumbliness.reason: Moist needled uncooked paste is creamy-cutting, not dry granular fracture.

firmness.reason: High moisture uncooked pressed body softened by blue proteolysis and needling.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism gives 2-phenylethanol 1400 ug/kg 10-fold vs other blues.

fruity.reason: Low esterification: ethyl butanoate 30 and ethyl hexanoate 60 ug/kg.

goaty.reason: Hexanoic C6 waxy note high but cow milk lacks goaty branched 4-methyloctanoic acids.

melt.reason: Rennet gel pH 5.9 with Ca 6.14 g/kg flows moderately, blue veins interrupt fusion.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Linoleate-derived 1-octen-3-ol only 62 ug/kg, low vs bloomy-rind cheeses.

oil_off.reason: 28.42% fat semi-soft releases some free oil on heating but not high-fat oiling.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked; guaiacol not found in volatile profile.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 801 mg/kg plus titratable acidity 2.01% lactic at pH 5.9.

stretch.reason: Non-filata rennet curd with no hot-water kneading, no extensible network.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine catabolism: dimethyl sulfide 8 and disulfide 24 ug/kg.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose fermented, slight sweet impression only from lactones.

umami.reason: High proteolysis SN 51.98% liberates glutamate peptides via rennet and P. roqueforti proteinases.
